items.q: Find the five-number summary (minimum, Q1, median, Q3, maximum) of 1, 3, 5, 7, 9.
items.qAf: Vind die vyfgetal-opsomming (minimum, Q1, mediaan, Q3, maksimum) van 1, 3, 5, 7, 9.
items.explain: Median = 5. Lower half 1, 3 gives Q1 = 2. Upper half 7, 9 gives Q3 = 8.
items.explainAf: Mediaan = 5. Onderste helfte 1, 3 gee Q1 = 2. Boonste helfte 7, 9 gee Q3 = 8.

items.explain: IQR = Q3 − Q1, the spread of the middle 50% of the data.
items.explainAf: IKO = Q3 − Q1, die spreiding van die middelste 50% van die data.

items.q: A value more than 1,5 × IQR beyond a quartile is called:
items.qAf: ’n Waarde meer as 1,5 × IKO verder as ’n kwartiel word genoem:
items.explain: Such values are unusually far from the rest of the data and are outliers.
items.explainAf: Sulke waardes is ongewoon ver van die res van die data en is uitskieters.

items.q: On a scatter plot, y decreases as x increases. The correlation is:
items.qAf: Op ’n spreidiagram neem y af soos x toeneem. Die korrelasie is:
items.explain: When one variable falls as the other rises, the correlation is negative.
items.explainAf: Wanneer een veranderlike daal soos die ander styg, is die korrelasie negatief.

items.q: A correlation coefficient of r = 0,95 indicates:
items.explain: A value close to +1 means a strong positive linear relationship.
items.explainAf: ’n Waarde naby aan +1 beteken ’n sterk positiewe lineêre verband.

items.q: A strong correlation between two variables does NOT by itself prove:
items.qAf: ’n Sterk korrelasie tussen twee veranderlikes bewys op sigself NIE:
items.explain: Correlation shows association only; a third factor may cause both.
items.explainAf: Korrelasie wys net assosiasie; ’n derde faktor kan albei veroorsaak.

items.q: A measure of how spread out data is around the mean.
items.qAf: ’n Maatstaf van hoe versprei data om die gemiddelde is.

items.q: The square of the standard deviation.
A graph of cumulative frequency against upper class boundaries.
items.qAf: ’n Grafiek van kumulatiewe frekwensie teen boonste klasgrense.

items.text: If the mean is greater than the median, the data is [[]] skewed. In a symmetrical distribution, the mean, median and mode are [[]].
items.textAf: As die gemiddeld groter as die mediaan is, is die data [[]] skeef. In ’n simmetriese verspreiding is die gemiddeld, mediaan en modus [[]].

items.q: Adding 5 to every value in a data set increases the standard deviation by 5.
items.qAf: Om 5 by elke waarde in ’n datastel te tel, verhoog die standaardafwyking met 5.
items.explain: False. The spread does not change; only the mean increases by 5.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Die verspreiding verander nie; net die gemiddeld neem met 5 toe.

items.explain: Mean = 5; squared deviations sum = 32; variance = 32/8 = 4; σ = 2.
items.explainAf: Gemiddeld = 5; som van gekwadreerde afwykings = 32; variansie = 32/8 = 4; σ = 2.
